title: [Control labelling sweep] Every visible button and link exposes an accessible name, so it is usable with a screen reader

requirement_ref.quote: A dedicated shopping cart icon to display or navigate to user selections.

summary: Verify every interactive control on the home page exposes an accessible name. The application did not behave as the requirement describes. A deterministic replay reproduced it identically, so this is not flakiness.
preconditions: STAGE is reachable and the home page loads

The sweep resolves aria-label, aria-labelledby, <label for>, wrapping labels, title, text content and child image alt before calling a control unlabelled — so a control named by any legitimate mechanism is not flagged.
expected: Every visible button and link exposes an accessible name, so it is usable with a screen reader.
actual:
all_controls_have_accessible_name: 28 checked, 1 failing
    - <a> — href="/cart" - icon-only - class="relative hover:scale-110 transition-transform"

1 element(s) failed "all_controls_have_accessible_name" (tolerance 0):
  - <a>: href="/cart" - icon-only - class="relative hover:scale-110 transition-transform"

rationale: The flow completed and 1 critical assertion(s) did not hold: A1.
Every action the agent performed succeeded, so the failure is in the outcome, not the operation.
A deterministic replay failed the same way.
